title: defaultReadOrchSessionId uses node:fs readFileSync, consistent with the sibling…
body: defaultReadOrchSessionId uses node:fs readFileSync, consistent with the sibling defaultReadOrchTranscript/defaultReadEventLog in this file (AC-directed mirroring) but against the Bun-first curated invariant (prefer Bun.file). File-local consistency is defensible here; a future sweep could migrate all three readers to Bun.file together.
